block.title: Block
block.description: They will be able to see your public posts, but will no longer be able to engage with them. {username} will also not be able to follow or message you, and you will not see notifications from them.

unblock.title: Unblock
unblock.description: They will be able to follow you and engage with your public posts.

unfollow.title: Unfollow
unfollow.description: Their posts will no longer show up in your Following timeline. You can still view their profile, unless their posts are protected.

unmute.title: UnMute
unmute.description: Posts from this account will now be allowed in your Home timeline.

removeFollower.title: Remove
removeFollower.description: {username} will be removed from your followers and won't be notified by Yappper. They can follow you again in the future.
